LanguageData.AllowDesignator.label: Allow selection
LanguageData.AllowDesignator.description: Unforbid all items in the selected area.\nClick and drag over an area to use.
LanguageData.ForbidDesignator.label: Forbid selection
LanguageData.ForbidDesignator.description: Forbid all items in the selected area.\nClick and drag over an area to use.
LanguageData.AllowAllDesignator.label: Allow everything
LanguageData.AllowAllDesignator.description: Unforbids all forbidden items on the map. Click to activate. Hold Ctrl/Option to include buildings. Hold Shift to include skeletons and non-fresh corpses.
LanguageData.SelectSimilarDesignator.label: Select similar
LanguageData.SelectSimilarDesignator.description: Selects only things similar to those already selected.\nHold Shift to pick additional things.\nHold Alt to ignore selection limits.
LanguageData.HaulUrgentlyDesignator.label: Haul urgently
LanguageData.HaulUrgentlyDesignator.description: Mark things to be hauled as soon as possible. Colonists will delay other work until hauling is complete.\nConfigurable in the Work tab.\nHold Shift to interrupt current colonist work.
LanguageData.FinishOffDesignator.label: Finish off
LanguageData.FinishOffDesignator.description: Quickly and painlessly kill downed creatures.\nHold Shift to include colonists and allies.
LanguageData.HarvestFullyGrownDesignator.label: Harvest fully grown
LanguageData.HarvestFullyGrownDesignator.description: Orders the harvesting or chopping crops and trees that are sufficiently grown to yield their maximum amount of resources when gathered.\nHold Shift to include only plants.\nHold Ctrl/Option to include only trees.
LanguageData.StripMineDesignator.label: Strip mine
LanguageData.StripMineDesignator.description: Lays out mine orders in a grid to maximize the chance to find hidden ores.\nHold Shift to show settings window or designate using current settings.
